picks.headline: Japanese court rules human voices are protected in landmark AI case
picks.excerpt: A Japanese court partly sided with an anime voice actor against an anonymous TikTok user who posted AI clones of his voice, ruling that a person's voice is protected by publicity rights — a precedent for singers facing unauthorised AI voice models.
picks.rationale: Follow-up with a new concrete event: the court's ruling that a voice is protected by publicity rights. The 9/30 card covered only the filing and TikTok's defence. Engadget chosen over CMU, which bundles the already-published US fair-use ruling.

picks.headline: Epidemic Sound partners with MyPart to bring adaptive music to PC gamers and streamers on Overwolf
picks.excerpt: Songhunt, an Overwolf in-game app, uses MyPart's multimodal AI to read gameplay in real time and pick matching tracks from Epidemic Sound's catalog across 1,500+ PC games, so streamers' soundtracks shift with the action.
picks.rationale: New shipping product: multimodal AI reads gameplay and picks licensed tracks in real time, so streamers' music adapts to the game. A concrete adaptive-music use case for creators.

picks.headline: Kelly Clarkson Shares Her 'Controversial' Take on AI: 'I Think It's Welcome to the Table'
picks.excerpt: Kelly Clarkson says she 'loves AI' and uses it artistically, but argues AI-made music should sit on separate charts rather than compete with human creations — a working artist's line on where AI belongs in the craft.
picks.rationale: A major artist says she uses AI in her work but wants AI music on separate charts. A fresh voice and a concrete proposal, and it differs from the earlier Fred again / Brian May / Todd Edwards cards.

picks.headline: SLEEP CLUB's New Music About The 'Intrusion' Of AI Got Incorrectly Flagged By Spotify's AI Systems
picks.excerpt: Band SLEEP CLUB's new single — about AI's intrusion into daily life — was again wrongly flagged by Spotify's AI-detection systems, after their whole catalog was previously mis-tagged: a false-positive problem for streaming AI labelling.
picks.rationale: A real false positive from Spotify's AI-music detection hitting human artists. This is a different story from the Qobuz tagging and LANDR fraud cards and the Hypebot LLM essay (its history_match).

picks.headline: Build a multi-agent music production pipeline on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime Instances
picks.excerpt: AWS walks through a three-agent music production pipeline (composition, generation, mixing hand-offs) sharing one GPU instance and filesystem — a reference workflow for agentic music creation.
picks.rationale: A hands-on reference build for agentic music production (composition, generation and mixing agents on one GPU). It is the most actionable workflow item in a pool with few tools.
